beats.care: If you turn 18 by 1 January 2027 in these states, fill Form 6 to get on the list. Telangana isn't in this round.
beats.what: The Election Commission announced a Special Summary Revision of voter lists in 17 states and union territories, including UP, Bihar, Tamil Nadu and Bengal.
beats.why: The aim is to enrol eligible voters, especially first-timers, and fix errors. It comes amid protests over names deleted during SIR.

cards.body: SIR rebuilds the list almost from scratch, with house-to-house checks. SSR is a lighter update of the existing list: adding new voters, fixing details and removing duplicate or dead voters, without door-to-door visits.
cards.title: ssr vs sir: what's the difference?

cards.body: In a shift, the EC will give parties draft and final lists as searchable PDFs instead of image files, a long-standing opposition demand. It had earlier refused, citing fears of misuse.

a.body: SIR removed too many names without proper checks, and the extra Form 6 declaration is unfair. They want the CEC removed.
a.label: Opposition parties say

b.body: Revisions keep lists accurate, and every registration officer must make sure no eligible citizen is left out.
b.label: The Election Commission says

opts: Add new voters and fix errors
cards.q: What's the main goal of the EC's Special Summary Revision?
cards.why: SSR updates existing lists, mainly to enrol young first-time voters and correct mistakes.

hook: Turning 18 soon? A *voter list update* just opened in 17 states

learn.t: You can apply early: people turning 18 on 1 April, 1 July or 1 October 2027 can already send in voter applications.
